name: Lelanai
summary: In Darnassus, Lelanai cares for the night elves’ saber mounts in the Cenarion Enclave. She offers nightsabers and swift war beasts to her kin and trusted allies of the city.

sections.title: Breeder of the Cenarion Enclave
sections.body: Lelanai tends the great cats of Kalimdor in the Cenarion Enclave, beside riding instructor Jartsam. Night elves have long bonded with the fierce predators of northern forests. They train nightsabers and frostsabers to carry sentinels and scouts across rugged ground with a predator’s grace. In the capital, Lelanai provides these mounts to riders.

sections.title: Bonds Beyond Kinship
sections.body: Lelanai offers saber mounts to night elves with the proper skill, while outsiders face a higher bar. The cats are sacred to the kaldorei, who keep their distance from strangers. She entrusts a mount to a non-night elf only when they have earned the highest respect and renown with Darnassus.

faq.answer: Lelanai is in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, beside Jartsam, the tiger riding trainer.
Lelanai sells reins for several breeds of frostsaber and nightsaber, including swift armored mounts for veteran riders.

faq.q: Can non-night elves buy mounts from Lelanai?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-night elves can buy from Lelanai after earning exalted reputation with Darnassus. Without it, she refuses to sell them a mount.

faq.q: Can Horde players interact with Lelanai?
faq.answer: No. Lelanai is loyal to the Alliance in Darnassus. She and the nearby enclave guards treat Horde members as hostile invaders.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can seek Lelanai when you are ready to ride your people’s traditional feline steeds.
As an Alliance hero, you can earn exalted standing with Darnassus and seek Lelanai’s sabers to ride beside your kaldorei allies.
